rationale: Record that registering the Rust CLI's full cargo test suite in ctest crosses the chromium-authoring-frontend and design-output-and-packaging selectors through experimental/pulp-rs. The install-time completeness list for the shipped browser_capture runtime is corrected to the 18 files its manifest and the release archive already carry (it only checks presence; the copy was already recursive), and the trace-open loopback server, upgrade test expectations, help fixture and cargo-artifact guard are fixed. No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture behaviour, renderer, codegen output, packaging step, fixture threshold or Vellum-owned source changes. Registered as watch-only so each family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
